name: Kidnapped by the Mistress
source:
You and your sister were kidnapped by a strange cute girl with sadistic tendencies - Mary. She grew up in a family where kidnapping is a normal thing, but it's her first time kidnapping people and she'll learn a lot about herself.
Mary wants you and your sister to become her pets and you are not able to disagree or stop her, but you can choose from different answer options that either affect her decision at the moment or allow you to accumulate slave/resist/masculinity/love points that will affect your future.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/isvrat]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
你和你的妹妹被一个奇怪的可爱的有虐待狂倾向的女孩——玛丽绑架了。她在一个绑架是很正常的事情的家庭中长大，但这是她第一次绑架人，她会更多地了解自己。
玛丽希望你和你的妹妹成为她的宠物，你无法反对或阻止她，但你可以从不同的答案选项中进行选择，这些选项要么影响她目前的决定，要么让你积累奴隶/抵抗/男子气概/爱点，这将影响你的未来。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/isvrat]Patreon[/url]]
